Detailed Usage
==============

This page provides a comprehensive reference for all command-line tools in the **ReconFSM** toolkit.

Converter Tool
--------------

The converter is the entry point for processing logs. It resides in ``reconfsm/converter/converter.py``.

.. code-block:: bash

   python converter.py <csv_file> <activity_type>

Arguments
^^^^^^^^^

*   ``csv_file``: The path to a CSV file generated by Plaso (using ``psort -w``).
*   ``activity_type``: The logic to use for extraction. Available types depend on the scripts in the ``scripts/`` directory.

Common Activity Types
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

*   ``web_activity``: Focuses on browser history, URLs, and downloads.
*   ``application_activity``: Focuses on systemd journal entries for app start/stop.
*   ``system_shutdown``: Focuses on power management and shutdown events.

Output
^^^^^^

Generated JSON machines are stored in:
``reconfsm/converter/json_machines/<activity_type>/<activity_type>_<timestamp>.json``

FSM Simulation Tool
-------------------

The simulation engine is located in ``reconfsm/fsm/fsm.py``. It allows you to analyze the generated FSM models.

.. code-block:: bash

   python fsm.py <json_file> <command> [options]

Commands
^^^^^^^^

graph
"""""
Generates a static visualization of the FSM.

*   **Output**: ``reconfsm/fsm/result/<machine_name>/visual.png``

pathfinding
"""""""""""
Calculates possible paths between states.

*   **Options**:
    *   ``-s, --state``: The target destination state (required).
    *   ``-d, --depth``: Maximum depth to search (default: 3).

Example:

.. code-block:: bash

   python fsm.py my_machine.json pathfinding -s "Target State" -d 10

Log Extraction with Plaso
-------------------------

ReconFSM is designed to work with **Plaso (log2timeline)**. Here is the recommended workflow to prepare your CSV data:

Step 1: Run log2timeline
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: bash

   docker run -v "$(pwd):/data" log2timeline/plaso log2timeline /data/timeline.plaso /data/evidence.E01

Step 2: Run psort
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

Export the timeline to a CSV format that ReconFSM can understand.

.. code-block:: bash

   docker run -v "$(pwd):/data" log2timeline/plaso psort -w /data/timeline.csv /data/timeline.plaso

.. note:: Ensure you use the ``-w`` flag in psort to generate a full CSV output.
